newsitem.title: USA: Correctional Systems names new president.
newsitem.headline: Correctional Systems names new president.

text.p: Correctional Systems Inc said Tuesday it hired John Forren as president and chief operating officer.
Forren was a former vice president and chief operating officer of Cornell Corrections.
In the release announcement, the company did not specify whether Forren replaced a sitting president.
Separately, Correctional Systems said San Fernando, Calif., City Council approved the proposal for Correctional Systems to manage a 40-bed Court Referral Facility.
The company said the it expects the deal to be completed within 30 days. After facility renovations, it expects the contract to add about $900,000 in annual revenues.
